notes: The owner opened Administration → Chat accounts — the first person to see it rendered — and asked for three things. All three shipped, and building the second found a defect in a guard. THE PORT FOLLOWS THE PROTOCOL AND THE ENCRYPTION. It was hard-coded to 5222; switching the dropdown to IRC left it there, which is exactly the kind of thing that produces a puzzling connection failure.
